goal: Correct the Kokoro Link presentation to show the selected reserve monster large in the center without slowing battle input.
acceptance_criteria: Each activation presents only the selected reserve monster large in the center.
The monster, Kokoro Link title, strong flash, and target receipt cue share one 600ms sequence.
The superseded side cut-in, attribute beam, and circular shock are removed.
No 300ms alternate sequence exists and battle busy state is not changed by the animation.
Reduced-motion users keep a calm centered presentation.
Save data, IDs, effect values, target binding, and activation rules remain unchanged.
